findings.problem: This wording makes CARLA sound like the execution/rasterization engine. The paper builds on PufferDrive, imports synthetic CARLA map geometry, and generates flat primitive observations with a custom CUDA rasterizer.
findings.requiredFix: Use the same interface boundary already present in the end-to-end review: state that the policy runs in a PufferDrive-based high-throughput multi-agent simulator, uses CARLA map geometry, and receives custom-CUDA-rasterized 96x54 flat primitive views. Keep the lack of real textures/weather/sensor noise and current code-unavailability limits.
